name: M'ONDUNIQ LaserIQ Enzym-Peeling
shortDescription: Grain-free enzyme peeling powder with papain and bromelain – exfoliates without mechanical irritation, so it can be used even on sensitive skin and skin with couperose. For preparing laser and IPL treatments.
description:
M'ONDUNIQ LaserIQ Enzym-Peeling is a professional, grain-free enzyme peeling powder that we developed for the gentle preparation of the skin before laser, IPL and other professional cosmetic treatments. Its innovative formula combines the natural enzymes of papaya (Papain) and pineapple (Bromelain) with soothing oat starch, so the product removes dead skin cells without mechanical irritation, while supporting the skin's natural renewal and preserving its comfort.

The effectiveness of laser treatments is significantly influenced by proper skin preparation. M'ONDUNIQ LaserIQ Enzym-Peeling gently removes dead skin cells, providing a cleaner and more even skin surface without causing mechanical irritation. This is especially important before treatments where the skin surface needs to be calm and intact.

The product is made for professional cosmetic use and can be applied as a standalone enzymatic exfoliation or as a preparatory step for laser and other aesthetic treatments. Recommended before diode laser hair removal, Carbon Peeling, Q-Switched ND treatments, IPL treatments, photorejuvenation, microneedling treatments, hydrodermabrasion treatments, anti-aging treatments, professional facial treatments and active-ingredient treatments, as well as part of professional facial cleansing.

Unlike traditional granular scrubs, enzymatic exfoliation does not cause micro-scratches or unnecessary mechanical stress, making it an excellent choice for sensitive skin, skin with couperose, rosacea-prone or reactive skin – while also being recommended for dull skin and all skin types. After the treatment, the skin becomes smoother, fresher and more even, while being optimally prepared for professional treatments and for receiving active ingredients applied later.

Application: Mix a small amount of powder with a little water until it reaches a light, foamy consistency. Apply to cleansed facial skin and spread evenly. Leave on for 5–10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

Caution: Enzymatic exfoliation is not recommended immediately after laser treatments. During the regeneration period, soothing and hydrating products are recommended. Size: 30 g / 1 oz.

faq.question: How do I mix it, and how long should it be left on?
faq.answer: Mix a small amount of powder with a little water until it reaches a light, foamy consistency. Apply to cleansed facial skin and spread evenly. Leave on for 5–10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

faq.question: Can it be used immediately after a laser treatment?
faq.answer: Caution: Enzymatic exfoliation is not recommended immediately after laser treatments. During the regeneration period, soothing and hydrating products are recommended. Enzym-Peeling is a skin preparation step before the treatment.
